## Bodmin planning approval

Cornwall Council has approved planning application PA26/03787 for 2 residential units at 7A Coinagehall Street Helston Cornwall TR13 8ER. The approved proposal is: Listed Building Consent to:- Merge two flats (7a & 7b) on the same floor. The layout will remain the same. Replacement partition wall with a timber stud wall with fireline board and fire resistant insulation

The application was decided on 07/09/2026. Construction Capital has reviewed the local market data for Bodmin, Cornwall to provide a high-level funding view for the site.
